checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: One assembled 15-second 16:9 film in three distinct shots
must.why: 15.1s widescreen clip with distinct shots visible across frames.

must.item: Woman keeps same face, freckles, red pixie cut in all three shots
must.why: Shot 2 shows her only from behind; freckles not visible. Shot 1 face is small and fairly unfreckled.

must.item: Man keeps same face, shaved head, round glasses in all three shots
must.why: Shot 2 shows only his bent bald head, no glasses or face. Shots 1 and 3 look consistent.

must.item: Both faces clearly visible in every shot
must.why: Shot 2 is a rear view of her and he is bent over with his face hidden.

must.item: Scarf dropped, picked up, returned in order, ending in mutual smiles
must.why: Frame 1 shows her holding the scarf, not dropping it. Frame 3 shows him holding it. The final frame shows mutual smiles, and she holds the scarf.

must.item: Realistic look and no audible soundtrack
must.why: The look is realistic, but the file has sound at a peak of -30.1 dB, so it is not silent.

faults.what: Shot 2 shows the woman from behind and the man bent over with his face hidden, which directly violates the request to show both faces clearly in every shot.
The video has an audio track, but the user asked for a silent film.
In shot 1 the scarf is draped around her and held, so the drop is not clearly shown. Her face is small and freckles are barely visible.
Her freckles are faint in shots 1 and 3 compared with the reference portrait.

summary: The film is realistic and the identities hold up in shots 1 and 3, but shot 2 hides both faces behind a rear view and a bent-over pose, the scarf drop is unclear, and the clip has an audio track despite the request for silence.
